meta.title: Methanol synthesis flowsheet example (assisted first draft)
unknowns: The source supplies no equipment, stream, instrument or valve tags; all unit and stream identifiers are newly assigned.

The order of feed mixing, the pre-reactor compressor and the pre-reactor heater relative to each other is not given; only that they precede the reactor. No connections between the mixer, compressor, heater and reactor are drawn.

The positions of the turbine and the cooler relative to the reactor and the Flash unit are not given. The list of units on L60 is a degrees-of-freedom list, not a stated process order. No connections between the reactor, turbine, cooler and Flash unit are drawn.
The Flash unit is described as post-reactor, but whether any equipment lies between the reactor and the Flash unit is not stated.
The source of the exhaust stream on L69 and the destination of any Flash vapor outlet are not specified.
No instruments, control valves, controllers, manual valves, relief devices, interlocks or limits are specified in the source.
Operating pressures, temperatures, duties, flows, compositions, line sizes, materials and valve failure positions are not given as plant values.
assumptions: Symbol dimensions and locations are proposed drafting geometry, not plant dimensions or nozzle locations.
The source names a turbine, but no supported type fits it. It is represented with the closest supported type, compressor, and keeps the source name.
Feed mixing is described (L10) but no mixer equipment is named. It is represented as a feed_header unit (M-101) for review.
The hydrogen and carbon monoxide feeds are represented as battery-limit streams entering the mixing unit, based on L10. This is an order-based interpretation for review.
The 'liquid outlet Product block' (L58) is represented as a Flash liquid stream to a battery limit, not as a separate unit. This is an interpretation for review.
Flash unit is represented as a separator; the pre-reactor heater and the cooler are represented as heat_exchanger units.
